steps.en: Install the ffmpeg CLI and the package
steps.zh: 装好 ffmpeg 命令行和 Whisper 包
steps.code: brew install ffmpeg · pip install -U openai-whisper

steps.en: Point it at your audio files and pick a model size
steps.zh: 把音频文件交给它，选一个模型尺寸

steps.en: Downloads the model weights on first use and caches them locally
steps.zh: 首次使用时下载模型权重，缓存在本地

steps.en: Decodes the audio with ffmpeg to 16 kHz and slices it into 30-second spectrogram windows
steps.zh: 用 ffmpeg 解码成 16 kHz 音频，切成 30 秒一段的频谱图窗口

steps.en: Detects the language and writes timestamped text window by window
steps.zh: 识别语种，逐个窗口写出带时间戳的文字

steps.en: Saves every output format next to each input
steps.zh: 为每个输入文件写出全部输出格式

value.en: Searchable transcripts and ready-to-load subtitles in many languages, produced on your own hardware with no per-minute fees
value.zh: 多语种的可检索文字稿和可直接加载的字幕，在自己的机器上生成，不按分钟付费

sources: https://github.com/openai/whisper README @ 8609812 (2026-08-31): Setup (pip install -U openai-whisper; brew install ffmpeg), Command-line usage (whisper audio.flac audio.mp3 audio.wav --model turbo), sliding 30-second window
whisper/transcribe.py cli: --output_format choices txt/vtt/srt/tsv/json/jsonl/all, default all
